headline: Binance Covers 90% of Assets Following Multi-Billion Dollar Hack
summary: Cryptocurrency exchange Binance reported it used its own resources, an emergency fund, and insurance to cover 90% of the funds stolen in a hack exceeding $6 billion. The remaining 10% has lower liquidity and may take longer to recover.
why: Binance is one of the world's largest cryptocurrency exchanges, and large-scale security breaches pose systemic trust and liquidity risks across digital asset markets.

impacts.name: Binance
impacts.why: Security breaches and asset losses negatively impact platform trust and token liquidity.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: A major cryptocurrency theft and subsequent recovery efforts directly impact platform liquidity and investor confidence in digital asset exchanges.
